summary: Iterates the audio/animation network node list and, for each scene-graph child flagged with bit 0x100 set at +20, scans its camera-distance entries, matches each entry's candidate name (built by ArithmeticComparison_7370) against a cached name buffer seeded from byte_5EA438, and for entries with valid animation float data computes the triangle normal, assembles vertex triples, and calls RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision to generate collision geometry. Returns the final node count.

operations.description: Seed the 61-byte name buffer v38: first byte from byte_5EA438, remaining 0x3C bytes zeroed via memset, terminator fields v39/v40 cleared.
Save this as v25; seed the cached lookup index v18 = -1 and the cached value v20 = 0.
AudioNetworkNodeCount(a2) returns the audio/animation network node count, stored in v26.
Outer do-while over the node count v26; LinkedListNodeFinder(v3) retrieves the network node at index v3.
SceneGraphChildCount(v24) returns the scene-graph child count v23 for the node.
Middle do-while over v23 children; LinkedListIndexedAccessor_c230(v5) yields each child entry v6.
Select only children whose dword field at +20 has bit 0x100 set (animation-driven mesh flag).
CameraDistanceGetter(v6) returns the camera-distance entry count v22 for the child.
Innermost do-while over v22 entries; ArrayIndexRead(v7) indexes the current entry by v7.
ArithmeticComparison_7370(v37) fills the candidate name string v37 for the current entry.
If v37 equals the cached name v38, reuse cached index v18 and value v20; otherwise perform a fresh lookup.
StringListLookup(v37) resolves the candidate name to a cached string id v8.
IndexedArrayAccess(v8) returns the animation metadata entry v9 for the resolved id.
Copy v37 into the cached name buffer v38 via a do-while string copy and update the cache: v18 = v8, v20 = v9.
Accept the entry only when its float fields differ: *(float*)(v9+8) - *(float*)(v9+12) * 0.0 != 0.0.
IndexedTransformRead(v7, v27, v29, v30) reads the transform for entry v7 into output buffers.
TriangleNormalComputation(v30, v31) computes the triangle normal from the transform data.
Emit geometry only when the normal computation succeeds (zero return) and area value v32 >= 0.001.
Assemble vertex triples: three-iteration copy loop scattering float values from the v28 source group into the v34 destination group.
RecursiveTriangleEdgeSubdivisionForCollision(v33, v35, v36, v16, a3) generates collision geometry from the assembled triangle.
Return the last node count value held in result (v26).
